entities.summary: Cemetery in rome, italy; an archaeological site on the via salaria in rome, italy, situated in what was a quarry in roman times. this quarry was used for christian burials from the late 2nd century through the 4th century. Catacomb of Priscilla is a archaeological site from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
